command:
from pathlib import Path
import json,traceback
from src.tools import t02_export_parallel as original
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
ROOT=Path.cwd();name="diag_t02_train_six_01_completed_summary_01";parent_name="t02_export_train_six_01_retry3"
metrics={"status":"failed","complete_by_kind":{k:0 for k in ("direct_flip","direct_stay","look_flip","look_stay")},"unknown_or_rejected_by_kind":{k:0 for k in ("direct_flip","direct_stay","look_flip","look_stay")},"units":[],"errors":[],"cache_authorized":False,"full_T02_acceptance":None,"scope":"Original completed child outcomes and allocation/source identity rechecked; no new raw scientific rerun or formal cache certificate."}
sources=[];exit_code=1
try:
 parent,pref=audited_result(ROOT/"results"/(parent_name+".json"));sources.append(pref)
 cfg,pm=parent["config"],parent["metrics"]
 assert parent["_meta"]["end"] and parent["_meta"]["exit_code"]==0 and pm["status"]=="original_exports_completed_cache_pending"
 assert pm["cleanup_errors"]==[] and pm["errors"]==[] and pm["all_units_ended"] is True and pm["unstarted_unit_indices"]==[]
 manifest,mref=original.read_manifest(Path(cfg["manifest"]),cfg["manifest_sha256"])
 assert manifest["entries"]==cfg["planned_units"] and len(pm["units"])==len(manifest["entries"])==6
 for index,(unit,entry) in enumerate(zip(pm["units"],manifest["entries"])):
  assert unit["unit_index"]==index and unit["entry"]==entry
  child,cref=audited_result(ROOT/unit["result_path"])
  assert all(unit["source"][k]==cref[k] for k in ("file","sha256","metrics_sha256","git_commit"))
  command=original.unit_command(parent_name+"_u"+str(index).zfill(4),entry,cfg["unit_timeout_seconds"],cfg["pair_timeout_seconds"],cfg["gate_timeout_seconds"])
  out=original.child_outcome(unit,child,cfg,command,entry)
  sources.append(cref);rows=out["original_pairs"];assert len(rows)==1
  row=rows[0];assert row["kind"]==entry["kind"]
  usable=(out["export_checks_complete"] is True and row["status"]=="exported" and row["native_evidence_verified"] is True and row["pair_checks_passed"] is True and row["table_complete"] is True)
  metrics["complete_by_kind" if usable else "unknown_or_rejected_by_kind"][entry["kind"]]+=1
  measured=row.get("export_measurements") or {}
  metrics["units"].append({"unit_index":index,"source":cref,"pair_id":entry["pair_id"],"dataset_key":entry["dataset_key"],"kind":entry["kind"],"usable_export_cache_pending":usable,"original_status":row["status"],"rejection_reasons":row.get("rejection_reasons"),"errors":out["errors"],"cleanup_errors":out["cleanup_errors"],"state_count":measured.get("state_count"),"shadow_divergent_states":row.get("shadow_divergent_states"),"in_clean_subset":row.get("in_clean_subset"),"worker_elapsed_seconds":row.get("worker_elapsed_seconds"),"render_elapsed_seconds":measured.get("elapsed_seconds"),"table_manifest":row.get("table_manifest")})
 metrics.update(status="original_terminal_outcomes_bound",pbs_jobid=cfg["pbs_jobid"],node=cfg["node"],gpu_uuid=cfg["cuda_visible_devices"],fixed_manifest=mref,cache_source_results=[row["source"]["file"] for row in metrics["units"] if row["usable_export_cache_pending"]])
 exit_code=0
except BaseException as error:
 traceback.print_exc();metrics["errors"].append(type(error).__name__+": "+str(error))
metrics["producer_exit_code"]=exit_code
output=ROOT/"results"/(name+".json")
with output.open("x") as stream:
 json.dump({"metrics":metrics,"config":{"name":name,"parent":parent_name,"scope":metrics["scope"]},"sources":sources},stream,indent=2,allow_nan=False);stream.write("\n")
print("FINAL_METRICS_JSON: "+json.dumps(metrics,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False))
raise SystemExit(exit_code)
